#!/bin/sh

kopia --disable-file-logging repository connect filesystem --path /mnt/repository/repo-kopia
kopia --disable-file-logging cache set --content-cache-size-limit-mb 30000 --metadata-cache-size-limit-mb 20000 --cache-directory /cache
kopia --disable-file-logging --progress snapshot create /mnt/DS418 --fail-fast

set -e
ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "$ARCH" in
  x86_64) BINARY="notify_push-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl" ;;
  aarch64) BINARY="notify_push-aarch64-unknown-linux-musl" ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
esac
echo "Downloading notify_push v1.2.1 for $ARCH..."
apk add --no-cache wget ca-certificates
wget -q -O /usr/local/bin/notify_push \
  "https://github.com/nextcloud/notify_push/releases/download/v1.2.1/$BINARY" || \
  (echo "Failed to download binary"; exit 1)
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/notify_push
echo "Starting notify_push..."
# Construct DATABASE_URL from environment variables
export DATABASE_URL="postgres://$${POSTGRES_USER}:$${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@$${POSTGRES_HOST}/$${POSTGRES_DB}"
echo "Environment variables:"
echo "  PORT=$${PORT}"
echo "  NEXTCLOUD_URL=$${NEXTCLOUD_URL}"
echo "  REDIS_URL=$${REDIS_URL}"
echo "  DATABASE_PREFIX=$${DATABASE_PREFIX}"
echo "  POSTGRES_HOST=$${POSTGRES_HOST}"
echo "  POSTGRES_DB=$${POSTGRES_DB}"
echo "  POSTGRES_USER=$${POSTGRES_USER}"
echo "  DATABASE_URL=postgres://$${POSTGRES_USER}:***@$${POSTGRES_HOST}/$${POSTGRES_DB}"
echo "Running notify_push..."
/usr/local/bin/notify_push || {
  echo "notify_push exited with code $?"
  exit 1
}
until nc -vz $${POD_NAME}.$${POD_NAMESPACE}.svc.cluster.local 5432; do echo "Waiting for postgres..."; sleep 3; done;
until nc -vz $${POD_NAME}.$${POD_NAMESPACE}.svc.cluster.local 5432; do echo "Waiting for postgres..."; sleep 3; done;

version: 1
base_url: http://jellyfin:8096
system:
  enableMetrics: true
  pluginRepositories:
    - name: Jellyfin Official
      url: https://repo.jellyfin.org/files/plugin/manifest.json
      enabled: true
    - name: Intro Skipper
      url: https://intro-skipper.org/manifest.json
      enabled: true
    - name: Streamyfin
      url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/streamyfin/jellyfin-plugin-streamyfin/main/manifest.json
      enabled: true
  trickplayOptions:
    enableHwAcceleration: true
    enableHwEncoding: true
encoding:
  enableHardwareEncoding: true
  hardwareAccelerationType: "qsv"
  hardwareDecodingCodecs:
    - h264
    - hevc
    - mpeg2video
    - vc1
    - vp8
    - vp9
    - av1
  enableDecodingColorDepth10Hevc: true
  enableDecodingColorDepth10Vp9: true
  enableDecodingColorDepth10HevcRext: true
  enableDecodingColorDepth12HevcRext: true
  allowHevcEncoding: true
  allowAv1Encoding: true
